EnsembleMCMC v0.0.5

Diff since v0.0.4

Changelog

No public API changes. Numerical fixes can change trajectories at extreme scales and through Gaussian rounding.

  • Preserve finite Stretch and DE proposals when intermediate subtraction or multiplication overflows.
  • Avoid overflowing full squared residuals in Gaussian replacement when the required half-quadratic remains finite.
  • Clarify Gaussian fallback invariance, synchronization borrowing, and kernel callback failure timing.
  • Strengthen numerical-scale, curved-target, and threaded failure tests.
  • Require Random123 1.5 or later and PrecompileTools 1.0.1 or later, excluding versions with build or precompile failures.

Merged pull requests:

  • Preserve finite ensemble proposals across extreme scales (#6) (@BJMCox)

  • Keep finite snooker projections under large coordinate translations and overflowing companion differences.
  • Prevent overflow during affine-rank validation by rescaling its owned workspace before centering.

item.content:encoded:
EnsembleMCMC v0.0.3

Diff since v0.0.2

Breaking changes

  • The generic verbs (initialize, step!, sample!, current_state, snapshot, synchronize!, validate_positions, acceptance_rate) are no longer exported. They are public on Julia 1.11 and later. Use using EnsembleMCMC: ... or qualified calls.
  • A NaN candidate log density is now a rejection. A +Inf candidate and a non-finite initial value still throw, and the error names the walker and the sweep.
  • GaussianReplacementMove defaults to shrinkage=:auto, an affine-invariant (1 + d/m) C proposal, so its results change.
  • Threefry4x streams changed, because set_rng! now resets the buffer position. Philox4x streams do not change.
  • ThreadedExecutor no longer calibrates or falls back to serial.

Changelog

  • Add acceptance_rate, sample!(...; thin) and ThreadedExecutor(; min_chunk).
  • Warn on -Inf initial log densities and on nearly degenerate ensembles.
  • Give clearer errors, and add early RNG partition-depth checks.
  • ThreadedExecutor rethrows the original exception.
  • Support BigFloat positions.
  • Fix KernelExecutor on wrapped CuArrays.
  • Fix Float32 Gaussian fit precision far from the origin.
  • Cut allocation per sweep from 21 KB to 1.9 KB. Kernel bookkeeping now runs in parallel.

Merged pull requests:

  • Review fixes: correctness, robustness, performance, API and docs (#3) (@BJMCox)

item.content:encoded:
EnsembleMCMC v0.0.2

Diff since v0.0.1

Changelog

  • Add Gaussian replacement moves and device-resident sampling through KernelAbstractions and the CUDA extension.
  • Add cached initial densities, transition details, state synchronization, position validation, and externally addressed sweeps for sampler adapters.
  • Improve proposal throughput and workload-aware thread scheduling, and precompile common sampling workloads.
  • Preserve rejected-transition metadata for degenerate proposals and run synchronization on the state's owning CUDA device.

Breaking changes

current_state and snapshot now include candidate positions, candidate log densities, and acceptance probabilities. Code that assumes the old record shape must change.

Random123 remains the RNG backend in this release.

Merged pull requests:

  • Expose transition data and state synchronization for sampler adapters (#2) (@BJMCox)
